title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Kupp (back) practices fully Thursday
items.desc: Cooper Kupp was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Kupp was upgraded after he was limited to start the week on Wednesday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Holani (knee) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: George Holani was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Holani was upgraded after he was limited on Wednesday to begin the week. He should be good to go in his depth role on Sunday against the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jadarian Price (chest) limited in practice Thursday
items.desc: Jadarian Price was limited in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Price has been limited in practice on back-to-back days to begin the week. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sam Darnold (glute) logs full practice Thursday
items.desc: Sam Darnold was a full participant in practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Darnold continues to trend in the right direction after he was limited to start the week on Wednesday. He is on track to return on Sunday against the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Mims has been limited at two-straight practices to start the week, so it's unclear which way he is trending for Week 3. Whether he's playing or not, fantasy managers shouldn't expect his injury status to come with a big impact for fantasy purposes this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: RJ Harvey (hamstring) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: RJ Harvey (hamstring) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Harvey missed last week's game due to a hamstring injury that he has been dealing with, but he was able to return to a full practice on Thursday, so it seems likely that he will suit up and play in Week 3. He will likely continue to share the backfield with J.K. Dobbins (hip), though it looks like rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) will be out of his hair for at least a week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jonah Coleman (ankle) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Jonah Coleman (ankle) did not take part in Denver's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie has now missed two-straight practices to start the week, so he seems to have an uphill battle to play in Week 3. RJ Harvey (hamstring) and J.K. Dobbins (hip) are both back to practicing in full, so it looks like they will be the two guys holding things down for Denver's backfield on Sunday.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Billy Bowman Jr. (Achilles) active for Thursday Night Football
items.desc: Billy Bowman Jr. (Achilles) is active for the Falcons' Thursday night game against the Packers.
items.impact: The Falcons get their starting nickel corner back against the Packers. He will provide much-needed help to their injured secondary.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jack Strand inactive on Thursday against Packers
items.desc: Jack Strand (healthy scratch) is inactive for Thursday Night against the Packers.
items.impact: Strand had a chance to show his stuff in the Falcons' loss to the Panthers, and his stuff wasn't great. Don't count on him to have many more appearances this season, and if he does, Atlanta players will be nigh unstartable.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: J.K. Dobbins (hip) logs full practice session Thursday
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins (hip) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Dobbins is expected to be good to go for Week 3 after being upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday. RJ Harvey (hamstring) was also able to practice in full, but rookie Jonah Coleman (ankle) was absent, so it looks like Denver's backfield is still expected to be at less than full strength in Week 3.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cooper Rush emergency 3rd QB for Thursday
items.desc: Cooper Rush will be the Falcons' emergency third QB for their game against the Packers.
items.impact: Rush was awful in his chances as a starter through two weeks, so heaven forbid he see his name called up again.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian O'Neill (knee) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Brian O'Neill (knee) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Vikings managed O'Neill's lingering knee issue by letting him remain limited on Wednesday, but he practiced in a full capacity on Thursday and should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers. His presence will be important for Minnesota's offense as a whole in what projects to be a favorable matchup in Week 3.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returns to practice Thursday
items.desc: Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) returned to Minnesota's practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran was unable to practice due to a knee issue on Wednesday, but he returned to practice on Thursday and was able to participate in a limited fashion. He's tracking towards playing in Week 3, but we won't know his official status for Sunday's game until sometime after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeeJay Dallas (toe) limited Thursday
items.desc: DeeJay Dallas (toe) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Dallas was unable to practice in full on Thursday and remained limited due to his toe injury. He seems likely to play this week still, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to play more than a depth role this week with Aaron Jones Sr. (knee) trending towards playing against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dareke Young (hamstring) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Dareke Young (hamstring) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Young should be good to go this week, as he was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited by a hamstring injury on Wednesday. He's not expected to be fantasy relevant for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brock Bowers (knee) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Bowers continues to trend the right way for Week 3. He was able to participate at practice again on Thursday, although he remained limited as the team continues to take caution with his recovery. It looks like he is gearing up to play this week, and if that's the case, he will return to being a must-start fantasy option, even if he is on a slight pitch count against the Saints.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jamel Dean (ankle) listed as limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Jamel Dean (ankle) was listed as limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran cornerback returned to practice and was able to participate in a limited fashion on Thursday, which bodes well for his Week 3 availability. His presence will be very important this week in a tough matchup against Joe Burrow, Ja'Marr Chase, and the rest of Cincinnati's stacked offense this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Jaylen Warren (shoulder) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Warren was able to take part in Pittsburgh's practice on Thursday in a limited fashion, which is a good sign that he will be available to play in Week 3. Rico Dowdle (toe) seems to be trending towards being out against the Bengals, which would leave Warren as the workhorse running back and a good fantasy option for the team this week if he's healthy.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning) limited Thursday
items.desc: Joey Porter Jr. (conditioning) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The young cornerback has been limited for conditioning purposes for a while now, so this designation comes as no surprise on Thursday. It remains to be seen if he will play this week or not, but Pittsburgh's secondary will see a massive upgrade if he's good to go against the Bengals.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) limited again Thursday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout was again a limited participant at practice on Thursday. He missed last week's game due to a foot issue, but he seems to be recovering well and will have a chance to play this week. We should know more about his status when the team's official game statuses get released after practice on Friday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Bailey (elbow) logs another full practice Thursday
items.desc: David Bailey (elbow) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Bailey's status for Week 3 looks good right now, as he has been a full participant at practice all week so far. His elbow injury is not a serious issue and it seems like a near certainty that he will play through it against the Lions this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) added to injury report Thursday
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) has been added to the injury report as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell wasn't on New York's injury report to start the week, but he has since been added due to a finger injury that prevented him from practicing in full on Thursday. This is a situation worth monitoring for fantasy managers throughout the rest of the week, as Mitchell saw 12 targets in last week's game and would vacate a lot of opportunities if inactive in Week 3.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mason Taylor (thumb) misses another practice Thursday
items.desc: Mason Taylor (thumb) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Taylor is at risk of missing Sunday's game. He has been sidelined at both of New York's practices to start the week, and it looks like the team is taking the cautious approach with his thumb injury at this point. If he's ruled out, expect rookie Kenyon Sadiq to see more work than usual in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Joseph Ossai (foot) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (foot) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It remains unclear if Ossai will play this week, as he has been limited at both of the team's practices so far. New York's defense would greatly benefit from having him available to play in a tough matchup against the Lions, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kene Nwangwu (back) still sidelined Thursday
items.desc: Kene Nwangwu (back) was still sidelined at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The Jets are likely to be without their veteran running back again in Week 3, as he was unable to take part in yet another practice on Thursday. His likely absence won't carry much weight from a fantasy perspective, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin) was absent from New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: To no surprise, the veteran defensive back missed yet another practice on Thursday. He's trending towards being sidelined again in Week 3, which is bad news for the Jets ahead of a very tough matchup against Detroit's elite offense on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (ankle) upgraded to limited Thursday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (ankle) was upgraded to a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was able to return to practice on Thursday after being sidelined due to an ankle injury on Wednesday. It looks like he's going to play this week, and if that's the case, he will see more work than usual in the event that Tyjae Spears (ankle) is unable to suit up against the Giants.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Daniel Bellinger (illness) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Daniel Bellinger (illness) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was added to the injury report on Thursday after starting out the week healthy. He's dealing with an illness right now and is likely considered day-to-day for the time being. Neither his presence nor his absence would have a big fantasy impact on Tennessee's offense this week, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (ankle) officially a non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (ankle) was officially a non-participant for the Titans on Thursday.
items.impact: As expected, Spears was unable to practice again on Thursday because of the ankle injury that he's dealing with. Tony Pollard (ankle) was able to return to practice, however, so it looks like he will be primed for a big workload this week if the 25-year old is sidelined.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Saquon Barkley (stinger) expects to play Monday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (stinger) told reporters that his MRI went well and he expects to play on Monday night.
items.impact: Barkley underwent an MRI after suffering a stinger in last week's win over the Titans, but the results were apparently good and he reportedly expects to play on Monday night against the Bears. Fantasy managers should still keep close tabs on his status throughout the rest of the week to ensure that will be the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) to avoid IR, expected to miss a few weeks
items.desc: Dallas Goedert (knee) will not be placed on injured reserve but is still expected to be sidelined for a few weeks.
items.impact: Goedert suffered a knee injury last week and the team considered placing him on injured reserve, but they are not going to do so, as he is only expected to miss a few weeks while he recovers. This is good news for fantasy managers of the veteran, but they will still need to find a substitute for him for the foreseeable future while he's out. Zach Ertz will step up and see more work for the Eagles in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chase Young (calf) upgraded to full participant Thursday
items.desc: Chase Young (calf) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Young's calf injury is not a serious issue, as he was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after being limited by it on Wednesday. He should play in what projects to be a favorable matchup against the Raiders on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kendre Miller (illness) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Kendre Miller (illness) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Miller is a new addition to New Orleans' injury report. He's dealing with some kind of an illness right now and wasn't able to practice on Thursday as a result. He's likely day-to-day for the time being, but of he's cleared to play on Sunday and Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) isn't, he will be primed for more work than usual against the Raiders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) officially limited Thursday
items.desc: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Etienne was a limited participant for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's still being affected by his hamstring injury, and it remains to be seen if it will affect his availability for Sunday's matchup against the Raiders or not. If it does, expect more work for Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller (illness) in that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran should be fine to play in Week 3, despite being limited at practice all week so far. Barring any setbacks with his recovery, he should be a full go against his former team on Sunday but still doesn't project to be a strong option from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cole Van Lanen (knee) again limited Thursday
items.desc: Cole Van Lanen (knee) was limited for another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Van Lanen's knee injury left him limited for another practice on Thursday. It doesn't look likely to leave him sidelined in Week 3, however, so Jacksonville's offensive line should be close to full strength against New England this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Robert Hainsey (elbow/groin) listed as limited Thursday
items.desc: Robert Hainsey (elbow/groin) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hainsey is dealing with a couple of different injuries right now and was limited on Thursday as a result. It looks more likely than not that he will play on Sunday, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) limited Thursday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) was limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Allen has had a habit of being limited at practice throughout the season so far, so it's unsurprising that he was a limited participant at practice again on Thursday. He's likely to play in Week 3, but he isn't likely to be relevant from a fantasy perspective.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) misses practice Thursday
items.desc: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) missed New England's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: It looks like Jones is trending towards being sidelined against the Jaguars, which is less than ideal for the Patriots, given that they already lack talent at the edge rusher position. Their defense will be weaker than usual if he is officially ruled out heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) practices in full Thursday
items.desc: Carlton Davis III (neck) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran has been a full participant at practice all week so far, so it looks like he will be available to make his return to the lineup for Week 3. His presence will be a nice boost for New England's secondary ahead of a tough matchup against the Jaguars this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) downgraded to non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Eli Raridon (thigh) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie suffered a thigh injury during last week's game. He was able to practice on Wednesday, but he was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday and was unable to practice at all. It looks like he's trending the wrong way for Week 3, which could lead to more work for Hunter Henry against the Jaguars.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Craig Woodson (shoulder) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Craig Woodson (shoulder) was absent from New England's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: New England's young defensive back missed a second-straight practice on Thursday after suffering a shoulder injury last week. It looks likely to leave him sidelined in Week 3, though we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Malik Nabers (shoulder) officially a full participant Thursday
items.desc: Malik Nabers (shoulder) was officially a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The star wideout was able to log a full practice session on Thursday after suffering this shoulder injury last week. It shouldn't affect his availability moving forward, but his fantasy value is still expected to be lower than it was before with Jameis Winston set to be New York's starting quarterback in place of the injured Jaxson Dart (knee) moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deonte Banks (calf) a limited participant Thursday
items.desc: Deonte Banks (calf) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Banks was sidelined due to this calf injury last week and remained limited on Thursday because of it as well. It's unclear whether or not he will play in Week 3, but New York's secondary will once again look significantly weaker if he's out against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brian Burns (ankle) officially DNP Thursday
items.desc: Brian Burns (ankle) was officially a non-participant at New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: New York is currently dealing with injuries to several of their key players, including Burns, who missed Thursday's practice due to an ankle injury. He seems to be at risk of missing Sunday's game against the Titans, which would make New York's defensive front significantly weaker in that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (ankle) listed as non-participant Thursday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (ankle) was listed as a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Thomas wasn't spotted during the open portion of practice on Thursday, and he did turn out to be a non-participant due to an ankle issue. It's currently unclear if it will have an effect on his availability for Week 3, but if it does cause him to miss time, New York's offense will be even further degraded than it already is due to the multiple injuries that they're dealing with.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Caleb Williams (hamstring) officially did not take part in Chicago's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Williams suffered a mildly serious hamstring injury last week and is expected to miss at least a game or two while he recovers. He wasn't able to practice on Thursday, which further solidifies that he is not going to make a surprise return and be ready to go in time for Monday night's game. It looks like Chicago may have to start Case Keenum this week with Tyson Bagent (concussion) also trending toward being sidelined against the Eagles, which would render most of Chicago's fantasy options unstartable for that matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hamstring) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (hamstring) was absent from Chicago's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Stevenson is currently considered week-to-week due to a hamstring issue, so it was no surprise that he was a non-participant at Thursday's practice. He seems like a longshot to play in Week 3, though we won't know for sure until sometime this weekend probably.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cairo Santos (hip) absent from practice Thursday
items.desc: Cairo Santos (hip) was absent from practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran is a new addition to Chicago's injury report, being listed with a hip issue that left him sidelined at practice on Thursday. There doesn't seem to be strong indications one way or the other about his status for Week 3, but either way fantasy managers shouldn't be looking to start him this week with Chicago's offense likely to be down to their second or third-string quarterback.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kyle Monangai (knee) doesn't practice Thursday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai (knee) didn't take part in Chicago's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Monangai missed Chicago's first practice of the week on Thursday. He's dealing with a knee injury right now and is considered day-to-day for the time being. It looks likely that he will be available to play on Monday night, though that is far from certain at this point.
